His personality: low grounded survival footwork, rough and economical, never elegant like Tsukiyo.
All poses face RIGHT in the same side/three-quarter game camera; same scale, costume, weapon length and anatomy in every cel. Always keep both hands on tachi, blade quiet diagonally down-right, head looking forward. Different actual leg poses, not translations of one illustration. Ren remains grounded, broad and wiry, with torn cloth following the motion modestly.

Use case: identity-preserve. Input image is REN's canonical master, preserve his rugged face, beard, tied hair, muscular body, torn black layered kimono, wraps, sandals, scabbard and long curved tachi. Detailed monochrome ink, true transparent background, opaque white fabric/skin. Game animation sheet of exactly FOUR full body poses in TWO columns TWO rows on SQUARE canvas. Every pose faces RIGHT with sword forward-right and eyes on opponent; movement is BACKWARD toward LEFT. Same head/body scale in all cells, no zoom. Leave large empty gutters, each complete body and sword tip entirely contained in its cell.
Draw a coherent four-frame defensive retreat shuffle, reading order:
0 rear/left foot slides left, weight on bent forward/right knee, tachi steady forward at waist height held in both hands.
1 weight transfers to rear/left planted foot, forward/right heel lifts slightly.
2 forward/right foot draws left toward body without crossing legs, blade remains covering opponent.
3 forward/right foot plants, restored broad low guard ready to repeat frame0.
Rough economical grounded footwork, knees bent, torso stable, NO sprint or forward stride, no turning away, no crossed feet, no jump. Make actual foot support visibly differ in four drawings. Same calm weapon position and garment silhouette, cloth lags mildly toward RIGHT. No text, labels, grid, floor, shadows, effects, blur or detached ink.
